name: orderflow
description: Monorepo do OrderFlow com backend Fastify, frontend React/Vite e MariaDB.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & wait'
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && JWT_SECRET=${JWT_SECRET:-test-jwt-secret} FRONTEND_URL=${FRONTEND_URL:-http://localhost:5173} DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:-mysql://test:test@127.0.0.1:3308/mesaflow_test} node --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.check:backend: npm run lint:backend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:integration: cd backend && node --import ./tests/helpers/integration-env.mjs --test-concurrency=1 --test-force-exit --import tsx --test tests/*.integration.test.ts tests/integration/*.integration.test.ts tests/waiter-calls.test.ts
scripts.staging:up: docker compose -p mesaflow-staging --env-file .env.staging -f docker-compose.production.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml up -d
scripts.staging:down: docker compose -p mesaflow-staging --env-file .env.staging -f docker-compose.production.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml down
scripts.staging:build: docker compose -p mesaflow-staging --env-file .env.staging -f docker-compose.production.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml build --pull
scripts.staging:restart: docker compose -p mesaflow-staging --env-file .env.staging -f docker-compose.production.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml restart
scripts.staging:logs: docker compose -p mesaflow-staging --env-file .env.staging -f docker-compose.production.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml logs -f
scripts.staging:ps: docker compose -p mesaflow-staging --env-file .env.staging -f docker-compose.production.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml ps
scripts.staging:config: docker compose -p mesaflow-staging --env-file .env.staging -f docker-compose.production.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml config
